_how_to_read: EXACT items are deterministic given the frozen inputs: string matching, anchor counting, parity arithmetic and the gate's decision logic contain no sampling. They must reproduce bit-identically; any difference is a real failure. APPROXIMATE items sit downstream of qwen2.5:7b generation. Even at temperature 0 and seed 42, Ollama output varies with model digest, quantisation, context length, GPU vs CPU placement and llama.cpp build, so they carry a tolerance. A reproducer must not treat an APPROXIMATE deviation inside tolerance as a failure, nor an EXACT deviation of any size as acceptable.

table1_anchor_counts.why: counted by NUMERIC_ANCHOR_RE over fixed LaTeX/JATS sources

table1_pdf_path_pooled.why: substring matching over frozen chunks; tolerance is display rounding only

table4_parity_precision.why: Criterion J is arithmetic over frozen survival numbers

table2_probe_outcomes_postF1.why: probes are fixed strings; the gate is deterministic

table3_case_count.why: the mutation suite is fixed; only the SCORES are approximate

table3_positive_control.why: CAUTION: the control outcome depends on judge scores and is only EXACT if the judge reproduces. Verify the judge digest first; if it differs, treat as APPROXIMATE.

table2_matrix_C.why: positives include paraphrase_llm mutants whose text qwen generates. One mutant flipping moves sensitivity by 0.20 at n=5 -- the denominator is the fragility.

table3_framework_detection.why: every value is a RAGAS Faithfulness score from a 7B judge; claim decomposition varies run to run. The QUALITATIVE finding (strict >> threshold on numeric perturbation) is the reproducible part, not the exact counts.

table3_structural_detection.why: structural side is deterministic; listed here only to sit beside its comparator

table5b_selector_isolated.why: field coverage is whatever qwen emits. DOCUMENTED INSTANCE: the confounded figure was +27/+31 in MEDICAL_RECHUNK and +26/+32 in MEDICAL_SELECTOR_CONTROL -- identical endpoint counts, ~1pp apart from rounding. Expect that magnitude.

wall_clock.why: hardware-bound. 122.8 s/paper pre-fix on the same machine; anything in that band is placement, not correctness.
